title: Implement panelized GF(p) PLE/LU — small-prime family (026fc832 Phase 6)
description:
Phase 6 implementation task under epic `026fc832`. Implements the panelized GF(p) PLE/LU kernel per the design in `2e8c5a29`.

Parent epic: `026fc832`. Predecessor: `2e8c5a29` (design), `40195c09` (lift).

## Amendment (2026-05-26, user-approved, session 9)

R0 (commits `a238ef36..6607005d`) closed 10/22 cells PASS: all GF(7), GF(31), GF(127), GF(241) cells, plus row 71. 12 cells SHORTFALL split by root cause:

**(a) GF(251) cells (8 cells, ratios 2.16-4.60×)** — structural: fflas uses recursive panel×panel PLUQ at ~30 Gop/s; gf2 panelized base kernel at ~8 Gop/s. **User chose: one R1 re-dispatch in scope of 6823c8a0 targeting recursive PLUQ.** If R1 closes GF(251) cells, 6823c8a0 closes PASS; if R1 walls, escalate again.

**(b) GF(65521) cells (4 cells, ratios 2.04-3.44×)** — design § 9 leaves the GF(65521) base case scalar; only Schur-update inherits fp_medium speedup. **User chose: amend SC#4 to defer GF(65521) PLE cells to follow-up task `68db401b`** ("u16-lane PLE base-case kernel (6823c8a0 Phase 6d)"), filed session 9.

**Amended SC#4 reads:** "Every A8 pluq cell PASSes (ratio ≤ 1.5× vs fflas) OR is closed by a named follow-up. GF(251) cells (rows 10-13 + new n=1024) are in-scope for 6823c8a0 R1 recursive PLUQ. GF(65521) cells (rows 14-17 + new n=1024) are deferred to `68db401b` and not required for 6823c8a0 closure."

All other SCs remain `[hard]` and are verified for closure.

## Background

Implements the design approved under `2e8c5a29`. Closes A8 rows 6-17, 71 (pluq cells over GF(7/251/65521) and GF(31)).

## Success Criteria (current — amended 2026-05-26)

- [hard] Production code implementing the panelized PLE per the approved design at `dev/active/2e8c5a29-panelized-ple-design.md`.
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness vs the existing scalar PLE on a proptest sweep across GF(7), GF(31), GF(127), GF(241), GF(251), GF(65521) at boundary lengths {0, 1, 15, 16, 17, 63, 64, 65} plus rank-deficient cases. Uses `proptest!` macros.
- [hard] 5-trial CCX1-pinned benchmarks on the 5900X reference host at n in {64, 256, 1024} for each of the 6 small primes, both uniform and rank-deficient regimes. Recorded as CSV + evidence doc.
- [hard] [AMENDED 2026-05-26 — see Amendment block above] Every A8 pluq cell PASSes (ratio ≤ 1.5× vs fflas) OR is closed by a named follow-up. GF(251) cells (rows 10-13 + new n=1024) are in-scope for 6823c8a0 R1 recursive PLUQ. GF(65521) cells (rows 14-17 + new n=1024) are deferred to `68db401b` (Phase 6d) and not required for 6823c8a0 closure.
- [hard] No regression on currently-PASSing GF(p) cells (delta ≤ 5%).
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-simd` / `gf2-kernels-hip`. `gf2-core` remains `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- [hard] Reuses the SSOT helpers named in the design (`barrett_reduce_lane32`, panel size constants).

## Original Success Criteria (pre-amendment, preserved for audit)

- [hard] Every A8 pluq cell (rows 6-17, 71) either PASSes (ratio ≤ 1.5× vs fflas) or carries an explicit user-approved [aspirational] amendment. Escalate cells that don't cross the threshold.

## Out of scope

- Echelon/invert/solve implementations (sibling tasks; depend on this).
- Mersenne31 PLE (not in scope of the design).
- GF(65521) PLE cells (deferred to `68db401b` per the 2026-05-26 amendment).

## Notes

- R0 dispatch (session 9, 2026-05-26) closed 10/22 cells PASS. Evidence at `dev/bench_results/2026-05-26-6823c8a0-panelized-ple.md`. CSV at `dev/bench_results/2026-05-26-6823c8a0-panelized-ple.csv`.
- R1 dispatch follows the user's session-9 choice to retry GF(251) cells with recursive panel×panel PLUQ blocking.
- Wave 7b (echelon/invert/solve) depends on this issue closing.
